description: Get the transactions of an earlier BankConv conversion by its conversion id (from convert_statement or list_conversions): ISO date, description, signed amount (money in positive) and running balance, with the bank, account, period and currency. Read-only; uses no pages. To save a file instead, use download_statement. Errors say what went wrong: not_found for an unknown conversion id, gone once a conversion was deleted under data retention (24 hours by default), unreadable_statement when the tables can't be read as transactions (the message names the row), insufficient_credits when the account has too few pages.

conversion_id.description: The conversion id, as returned by convert_statement or list_conversions.

tables.description: Advanced: which tables to read, as page:table indexes from 0 ("0:1,1:0"). Leave out and BankConv picks the transaction tables.

name: get_transactions
title: Get the transactions of a conversion
